name: Tweaks
description: Propwash server tweaks: dropped items are deleted (except for players tagged propwash.exempt); vanishing and un-vanishing (Vanish mod) show at once; /mydrone brings your own drone to you; your drones are removed when you leave; the debug stick works in the plot world (/debugstick); fireworks have a 2-second cooldown; the server exits as soon as it has stopped (WorldEdit timer).
